notes.title: Marching forward to March! (Updated Release Date)
notes.notes:
Hello friends, fans, and mom! David here from Brave Lunch with a little update about Blobkin. 
We've decided as a team to push our release date back to March 2021.

We had an incredible beta (200 sign ups!) and had a great response. The number one wish though? More stuff! More levels, content, weapons, moar moar :)  Along the way we also encountered a lot of bugs that need some attention, particularly the hostile movements.  Plus let's be honest, this holiday season is going to be crazy with new releases (Cyberpunk 2077 anyone? ✋🤚)

So the team decided to push back to March! More time to focus on adding enemies, weapons, combat and new levels, like this little gem from team member Josiah Poling:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37856864/4f5adc30666501df724748ede35da22c0c59886e.png[/img]
An eerie new level, deep below the sea, at the edge of an oil rig. What dark mysteries lie so deep below?

For those of you on the beta: don't worry! Your keys will be active as we push out updates, we're aiming monthly right now (new one in two weeks!) And for those of you who wish to sign up, [b][url=https://www.bravelunch.com/blobkin-blaster#email]toss me an email[/url][/b] and I'll make sure you get on the next batch :)

We're so excited to show you what we have in store, but for now, back below to developing we go...

🤿🐟💙💧

notes.title: An Update from the Reef #1 + Beta Weekend in August! 🤿🔫
notes.notes:
Hello friends, fans (and hi mom!)

Our team over here at Brave Lunch is hungrily banging the keyboard at making Blobkin Blaster! We've got a new pistol blaster (your main starting weapon), plus we've got XP and level progression built in! Woohoo! Let's take a look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37856864/d304c154deb722d4a6e31b4fcd0e3967c712c2cc.gif[/img]

Plus, there's a new weapon we're working ([url=https://twitter.com/bravelunch/status/1285274651476791297]potentially inspired by this[/url]). And we've been refining the wave mechanics so you don't get swarmed immediately.

Our goal is by the end of August to have a BETA WEEKEND! Play the first level, blow up monsters, and enjoy the calming rhythm of the sea :)

That is... until the clam boss shows up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37856864/0d9f0abd7484369168d2c7b5734cbd4d1e84cb76.jpg[/img]

All of this has made us think, there should be a new genre of game out there.. SCUBA Shooter! It's like an FPS, but with underwater physics!

See you at the reef real soon. 💙💧

-

[h2]Do you have a Discord? Do you enjoy pictures of pets and babies? Then come join us! -> [url=https://discord.gg/SvxFPd5]https://discord.gg/SvxFPd5[/url][/h2]
